basic_profile.bio: I am a dedicated audio engineer based in Portland, Oregon, with a deep passion for high-fidelity sound. My journey into audio engineering started in college where I majored in Sound Design and acquired hands-on experience working at a local recording studio. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings after work and during weekends. I am currently working as a freelance audio technician and am happily married with two kids. In my free time, I enjoy exploring niche music genres and enhancing my home audio setup.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in Sound Design and over a decade of experience in the audio engineering industry. My expertise extends to digital audio workstations, mastering techniques, and high-resolution audio formats. I continue to expand my knowledge through workshops and online courses.
